ValidationRule.description: Only an active member can receive an active reward at its current price and partner.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only an active member can receive an active reward at its current price and partner.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISNEW(), OR(NOT(Reward__r.Is_Active__c), Partner__c <> Reward__r.Partner__c, Points_Spent__c <> Reward__r.Points_Cost__c, Value_CZK__c <> Reward__r.Value_CZK__c, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Member__r.Membership_Status__c, "Active")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Issued"))))
